registered_after: N2.3 found different configuration digests; read-only inspection of five existing .o.cmd files, compiler token shapes and file existence. No new preprocessing results have been read.
purpose: Remove the known source/configuration mismatch for the selected old s390/x86 pair, without treating helper calls as completed preparation.
execution: Read the original single gcc command from each .o.cmd, reject shell operators/substitution and unsupported tails. Use shlex tokens with shell=False in the same build cwd. Remove the one -Wp,-MMD dependency token and replace only the exact -c -o object source tail by -E -o new-cache-output source. Preserve all other tokens. No make, configuration regeneration, object compilation, linking, kernel boot or model request.
checks: Before preprocessing verify archived configuration, image, initramfs and instrumented source digests. Hash the selected five .o.cmd files, all ten retained objects, two configurations, generated config/release headers, two images/initramfs and six recorded observer source files plus selected getter header before and after. Record compiler identities and exact original/new argv; remove compiler output/include override environment variables. cpu_smt_mask selector is include/linux/topology.h, other selectors bind the named translation unit source. Abort if commands are ambiguous or protected bytes change. A check failure is not repaired in place.
outputs: Full preprocessing only in a new WSL cache directory; executable collector, command results, exact selected lexical regions and provenance in this new experiment directory. Preserve all historical data.
analysis_limits: Existing known case and instrumented source, not an independent sample. Region extraction is lexical, not path/effect/coverage proof. Current header files and compiler are not all cryptographically recorded at original build time; even matched config/source/image cannot certify an exact historical compiler replay. Do not overwrite raw N1 CFG or N2.1-3 selection/profile outputs. No new helper expansion or defect claim.
exit: Save actual extraction success or insufficiency, independently review a bounded provider/consumer source relationship, and update the current checkpoint. Any subsequent semantic feature upgrade needs separate evidence.
